uncertainties: pt-BR amounts: 'quantias' (the sum-of-money sense) was replaced, not kept. 'quantidades' is correct for the food-and-drink context and can still cover money in general use, so I did not flag it. Restore 'quantidades; quantias' if the lemma is shared with monetary contexts elsewhere.
hi/bn/ur herself/himself: the gender tag '(स्त्री)/(পুরুষ)/(عورت)' etc. now sits after the second gloss only. It reads as applying to both, so this is presentation, not an error.
vi sapphire: 'đá sapphire' is a loanword gloss. 'lam ngọc' is the native alternative, and removing 'ngọc bích' fixes a common jade/emerald ambiguity, so there is no error.
ru wardrobe: removing 'шкаф' leaves 'гардероб', which still covers both the furniture and the clothing-collection senses, so no valid meaning is lost.
bn accidentally: removing 'হঠাৎ করে' (suddenly) drops an incorrect sense, not a valid one.
summary: All 92 changes (2 tr source, 90 across es-419, pt-BR, id, ar, vi, hi, ru, bn, ur, th) were compared against the English contexts and the Turkish references. No substantive regressions were found. The changes correctly add missing senses: tie as noun, unlit as not lit (of a cigar), curled hair, intransitive weakened, call as a vocal call, and reflexive object forms. They also fix prior errors: hi Thumbelina 'ring' removed, ar endangering changed from passive to active, bn accidentally 'suddenly' removed, ru poured/slipped/apart/sending. No sense, role, or language errors were introduced. The remaining notes are minor uncertainties, not defects.
